liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Playing In The Band** (3 reviews): The Playin' jam on the soundboard section is described as cosmic; The soundboard Playin' > Wharf Rat > Playin' sequence is described as totally unhinged and unlike anything else [9][11][16]
- **Eyes Of The World** (2 reviews): Eyes of the World is also strong, in the soundboard portion; After Eyes, the band seemed to head toward China Doll but guitars went out of tune, leading into Sugar Magnolia [9][19]
- **Brown Eyed Women** (1 review): Brown Eyed Women is a nice version for 1974, not as lean as many others [15]
- **China Cat Sunflower** (1 review): The China Cat jam stands out in the reviewer's memory [19]

## The recordings

- **gd1974-06-08.sbd.miller.97268.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 22 songs; 184 min; rated 4.91/5 by 11 [1]. Said about its sound: Charlie Miller's remaster is praised, and the audience patch sounds good too [17]
- **gd1974-06-08.sbd.smith-lee.GEMS.97182.flac16**: soundboard; 22 songs; 184 min; rated 4.6/5 by 15 [2]
- **gd74-06-08.aud.clugston.2365.sbeok.shnf**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 22 songs; 168 min; rated 4.43/5 by 7 [4]. Said about its sound: The recording has hiss and distant vocals, similar to the Steal Your Face album; The audience tape is quite listenable, with the soundboard section being the essential part; Soundboard kicks in during Playin', which may lead listeners to overrate that segment [10][11][12]
- **gd1974-06-08.176520.sony.ecm250.falanga.menke.miller.clugston.new.flac2496**: audience recording; 23 songs; 165 min [5]. Said about its sound: The first notes of Ship Of Fools are clipped, with no patch source available [5]
- **gd1974-06-08.fob.sonyECM250.falanga.motb-0080.94594.flac16**: source not stated; 22 songs; 166 min; rated 4/5 by 2 [8]. Said about its sound: Strong audience tape with a few reel quivers; instrument and vocal levels are solid; Very good audience recording that conveys the Wall of Sound ambiance better than sterile, compressed soundboards [15][20]

## Around the show

- Hot day at a Day on the Green; the listener moved from the field to the stands for shade [10]
- The bill included the Beach Boys, New Riders and Commander Cody; the Beach Boys seemed out of place but played well [10]
- Other artists on the bill were the Beach Boys, NRPS and Commander Cody [3]
- New Riders of the Purple Sage opened the day [5]
- The show was one of Bill Graham's Day on the Green events, with the Wall of Sound at the Coliseum [22]
- Reviewer finds audience tapes of the Wall of Sound era preferable to soundboards, which sound sterile [20]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1974-06-08.sbd.miller.97268.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Set 1 + Encores: SBD -> Master Reel -> Reel -> Reel -> Wavelab -> FLAC Set 2: SBD -> Master Reel -> Dat -> Wavelab -> FLAC [1]. Also: Source chain: Sony ECM250 to master cassette to FLAC; Bob Menke supplied the audience source, with pitch correction help from Joe B. Jones; This is a remaster of an earlier release (shnid 97182), with the audience patch covering Playing In The Band [1]
- **gd1974-06-08.sbd.smith-lee.GEMS.97182.flac16**: taped by Will Boswell, Pat Lee; transferred by Matt Smith; source: Set 1 & encores MR>R(JG)>R(WB & Pat Lee)@ 3 3/4 ips. Set 2 Lineage: MR>DAT Transfer info: Apogee Mini ME 24/96>Apogee Mini DAC(monitoring)>Wavelab 5.0(dithered… [2]. Also: Audience patch in Playin', the first two songs of set 2 and Sugar Magnolia come from Bob Menke's MOTB transfer [2]
- **gd74-06-08.aud.clugston.2365.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard and Audience composite [4]. Also: The matrix combines an audience recording with a soundboard portion that runs about 65 minutes [9]
- **gd1974-06-08.176520.sony.ecm250.falanga.menke.miller.clugston.new.flac2496**: taped by Louis Falanga; transferred by Bob Menke, Charlie Miller, Scott Clugston; source: Louis Falanga's Master Audience Cassettes; Sony ECM 250 mic > Sony TC-110 (Maxell UD C120) [5]
- **gd1974-06-08.fob.sonyECM250.falanga.motb-0080.94594.flac16**: taped by Louis Falanga; transferred by Bob Menke and Paul Gilbert; source: (FOB) 1 x Sony ECM250 => Sony TC-110 => 3 x Maxell UD C120's [8]. Also: Reviewer thinks this audience source matches the partial audience tape with a soundboard Playin' segment, the only other source [15]

## Art and photos

- Poster by lostlivedead.blogspot.com: [June 8, 1974 Oakland Coliseum Stadium, Oakland, CA: Grateful Dead/Beach Boys/New Riders of The Purple Sage/Commander Cod](https://lostlivedead.blogspot.com/2011/05/june-8-1974-oakland-coliseum-stadium.html) [26]
- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Oakland Coliseum Stadium - June 8, 1974](https://www.dead.net/show/june-8-1974) [27]
- Photo by Zoooma (All rights reserved): [Grateful Dead - Day On The Green - 6/8/74 Oakland-Alameda County Coliseum, Oakland, California copyright unknown](https://www.flickr.com/photos/9692677@N07/3609601283/) [28]
- Photo by Zoooma (All rights reserved): [Bill Graham poster for Day On The Green #1 - 6/8/74 Oakland-Alameda County Coliseum - with Grateful Dead, Beach Boys, NR](https://www.flickr.com/photos/9692677@N07/3610404700/) [29]
